{
  "dataset_name": "electricity",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "price_ratio_nsw_vic",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of NSW price to VIC price, log-scaled to handle skew and near-zero VIC prices. Captures relative price spread between states.",
      "value_range": [-5.0, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "price_relationship",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes cross-state price geometry; similar ratios cluster together in KNN space",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(nswprice) - np.log1p(vicprice)"
    },
    {
      "name": "demand_balance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between NSW and VIC demand, normalized by their sum. Captures demand imbalance between states.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "demand_relationship",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Demand balance is a key geometric axis for KNN neighborhood separation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(nswdemand - vicdemand) / (nswdemand + vicdemand + 1e-6)"
    },
    {
      "name": "total_demand_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of NSW and VIC demand divided by 2, representing average system-wide demand level.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "demand_aggregate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregate demand level helps KNN find neighbors with similar overall system load",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(nswdemand + vicdemand) / 2.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "price_demand_interaction_nsw",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Product of NSW price and NSW demand, capturing joint price-demand state for NSW.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 0.9],
      "feature_family": "price_demand_interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Joint price-demand signal improves neighborhood geometry for electricity market states",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "nswprice * nswdemand"
    },
    {
      "name": "transfer_deviation_from_mean",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation of transfer from its training mean (0.4987), normalized by training std (0.1528).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.5],
      "feature_family": "transfer_anomaly",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Standardized deviation helps KNN measure distance from typical transfer values",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(transfer - 0.4987) / 0.1528"
    },
    {
      "name": "period_cyclical_sin",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sine transformation of period (scaled to 2*pi), encoding cyclical time-of-day structure.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal_cyclical",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Cyclical encoding preserves circular distance structure for time-of-day in KNN",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sin(period * 2.0 * 3.14159265)"
    },
    {
      "name": "period_cyclical_cos",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Cosine transformation of period (scaled to 2*pi), encoding cyclical time-of-day structure.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal_cyclical",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Paired with sine, provides full cyclical representation for KNN distance computation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.cos(period * 2.0 * 3.14159265)"
    },
    {
      "name": "vicprice_log_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log1p transformation of VIC price to reduce extreme skew from near-zero values.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 0.2],
      "feature_family": "price_transform",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Log scaling of highly skewed VIC price improves Euclidean distance meaningfulness in KNN",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(vicprice * 10.0) / 10.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_demand_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator for whether combined NSW and VIC demand exceeds 0.75 (high system load).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "demand_regime",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Cluster indicator for high-demand regime improves KNN neighborhood purity",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((nswdemand + vicdemand) / 2.0 > 0.75, 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "price_spread_magnitude",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute difference between NSW and VIC prices, capturing cross-state price divergence.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 0.97],
      "feature_family": "price_relationship",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Price spread magnitude is a key distance axis for electricity market state similarity",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(nswprice - vicprice)"
    },
    {
      "name": "temporal_market_context",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic score (0-1) reflecting how much the combination of date position and period suggests a peak market activity window. Higher values indicate mid-year, mid-day periods with historically higher volatility patterns.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal_context",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures non-linear temporal context that improves KNN clustering of similar market periods",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "supply_demand_stress_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic score (0-1) reflecting overall market stress based on joint assessment of price levels relative to demand levels for both states. Higher values indicate high prices with high demand, suggesting supply stress.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "market_stress",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Composite stress indicator helps KNN identify neighbors in similar market stress regimes",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
